nodes.description: uint256 public constant PERIOD = 30 minutes; minimum elapsed time required between oracle price updates.
address public immutable override factory; trusted factory used to resolve pairs and sort tokens.
mapping(address => Observation) private pairObservations; stores TWAP observations keyed by pair address.
Oracle constructor: validates _factory is non-zero and stores it in the immutable factory state variable.
external view returning the stored observation fields (timestamps, cumulative prices, averages) for a token pair.
public override updatePair(address pair): initialises or refreshes cumulative price observations, enforcing PERIOD between updates.
external override update(tokenA, tokenB): resolves the pair from the factory and delegates to updatePair.
external view override consult: converts amountIn to amountOut using the stored TWAP average for the sorted pair.
internal view helper returning uint32(block.timestamp % 2**32) - direct read of the block timestamp.
internal view computing counterfactual cumulative prices from pair reserves and elapsed time.
FixedPoint.fraction(numerator, denominator): left-shifts the numerator by 112 bits and divides by the denominator.
FixedPoint.mul(self, y): multiplies the fixed point value by y, reverting on overflow.
FixedPoint.decode144(self): right-shifts by 112 bits to truncate the fixed point value to uint144.
SafeMath.add: addition with overflow check wrapping the raw uint addition.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction with underflow check wrapping the raw uint subtraction.
SafeMath.mul: multiplication with overflow check wrapping the raw uint multiplication.
block.timestamp - miner/validator influenced value read by currentBlockTimestamp and used for TWAP period logic.
uint32 timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - observation.blockTimestampLast; unchecked uint32 subtraction (overflow intentionally desired).
(price0Cumulative - observation.price0CumulativeLast) / timeElapsed and the price1 equivalent - unchecked cumulative subtraction and division.
price0Cumulative += uint(fraction(reserve1,reserve0)._x) * timeElapsed and price1 equivalent - unchecked overflow-prone accumulation.
(uint224(numerator) << 112) / denominator - bit-shift scaling and division in FixedPoint.fraction.
uint(self._x) * y performed inside FixedPoint.mul with an overflow require check.
